what: A preview of a published agenda, for notice. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; nothing here predicts an outcome. Every agenda_line is verbatim from the document.

preview.hook: Cell phone rules, field trip policy, and new seclusion/restraint regulations up for discussion
preview.how_to_attend: In person at Turkey Hill Elementary School, Superintendent's Office; public comment periods are listed on the agenda

items.agenda_line: a. Time Out and Seclusion Policies-Important Updates to 603 CMR 46.00-took effect August 2026 redefining physical space requirements and emergency seclusion protocols
items.why_it_matters: The state changed the rules governing how schools may physically restrain or seclude students, and the sub-committee is discussing what that means for district policy.

items.agenda_line: b. MA Leads Act: Economic Development Act
items.why_it_matters: The sub-committee is discussing this state law and any implications for school policy.

items.agenda_line: c. Protect Act-Interacting with Law enforcement officers engaged in civil law enforcement
items.why_it_matters: The sub-committee is discussing policy on how school staff interact with law enforcement conducting civil immigration enforcement, which affects students and families.
The district's rules for student field trips are under review, which affects families and students who take part.
The district's rules on student cell phone use are under discussion, directly affecting students and daily classroom practice.

preview.one_line: School Committee Policy Sub-Committee, Sept 25, 9:30am: discussing seclusion/restraint rules, field trip policy, and cell phone policy.
preview.where: Turkey Hill Elementary School, Superintendent's Office
